title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 22 in B-flat minor

character.text: Stile antico exposition fugue with stretto, in motet style

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 14) in part, with the soprano ii's line in the tenor, the tenor's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Soprano I: free counterpoint. Soprano II: a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted (3 times), in a sequence rising by a third every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject.

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in E♭ minor (Soprano I); Answer in B♭ minor (Soprano II); Subject in B♭ minor (Tenor)
Link
sections.summary: Soprano I: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted.

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 14) in part, with the soprano i's line in the alto, the soprano ii's line in the tenor, the tenor's line in the bass, transposed. Soprano I: free counterpoint. Soprano II: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times). Bass: a figure from the subject.

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 5–9), with the soprano i's line in the bass, at the same pitch level. Soprano II: a figure from the subject, inverted. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted and a figure from the subject.

sections.label: Stretto: Answer in F minor (Bass); Subject in E♭ minor (Soprano I); Subject in A♭ minor (Soprano II)
Link
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in E♭ minor (Tenor); Subject in A♯ minor (Soprano II); Subject in F minor (Alto)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 14) in part, with the alto's line in the bass, the tenor's line in the alto, a step higher. Soprano II: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (4 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: a figure from the subject.

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in B♭ minor (Soprano I); Subject in F major (Soprano II); Subject in B♭ minor (Alto); Subject in F major (Tenor); Subject in B♭ minor (Bass)
Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano I: free counterpoint. Soprano II: a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted.

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano I: free counterpoint. Soprano II: a figure from the subject, inverted. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 39–47).

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano I: free counterpoint. Soprano II: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted. Returns in Episode 1 (bars 17–24). Returns in Episode 2 (bars 34–36). Returns in Episode 4 (bars 57–67).
